senses.gloss:
m. (-विद्)
A general reader, but not a profound one.
E.
प्रघटा said to imply novelty, and विद् who knows.

m. (-णः)
1 A terrace before a house.
2 A copper pot.
3 An iron crow or club.
E.
प्र before हन to strike, aff. अप्, and the radical letter changed; also प्रघाण.

m. (-णः)
A covered terrace or small portico before the door of a house.
E.
प्र before हन to strike, (with the feet,) aff. अप्, and the radical vowel changed optionally; also प्रघण.

m. (-नः)
1 A covered terrace before a house.
2 A sort of bean, (Phaseolus mungo.)
E.
प्र before हन to strike or hurt, aff. अप्.

m. (-नः)
A covered terrace before the door of a house, a porch, a portico: see प्रघन, and प्रघण.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Voracious.
m. (-सः)
1 Eating much.
2 A Daitya, a demon.
E.
प्र much, घस for अद to eat, aff. अप् or अच्.

m. (-तः)
Combat, battle.
E.
प्र violently, घात striking; also प्राघात.

m. (-तः)
War, battle.
E.
प्र before हन to kill, aff. घञ्, and the vowel of the prefix optionally made long.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Turning round or rolling violently.
2 Wandering, roaming.
m. (-र्णः)
A guest, a visitor.
E.
प्र before घूर्ण to turn round, aff. अच्.

m. (-कः)
Sound, noise.
E.
प्र much, घोष sound, aff. कन्.

m. (-रः)
Dropping, oozing, trickling, aspersion, or pouring out of any oily substance.
E.
प्र before घृ^1 to sprinkle or drop, aff. घञ्.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161123. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/321.

m. (-णः)
A guest, a visitor, one demanding hospitality.
E.
प्र and आङ् before घुण to turn round, aff. क.

m. (-कः)
A guest.
E.
प्र before घूर्ण going about, aff. ठक्.
